title: Strange Creatures in My Schoolbag
summary: Pat never cleans his schoolbag, and one evening he finds strange, scary creatures sitting on it. How did they get there, and what does he have to do to make them go away?
pages:
Pat's schoolbag is very dirty.
He stuffs everything into it.
His schoolbag is dirty and yucky.

On Sunday evening he looked for his schoolbag.
He looked, and looked, and looked! He had to get his schoolbag ready for the next morning.

At last he found the schoolbag under the bed.
He got a fright, because...
Strange creatures were sitting on his schoolbag.

First, a creature that squirts ink scared him.
"Out! Out!" Pat shouted.

Next, a creature made of fruit peels came close to him.
"Out! Out!" Pat shouted.

He didn't understand what was happening, but the creatures made him feel dirty.
He was terribly scared, and more and more strange creatures came close to him.
There was no way he could fight the strange creatures.
Pat said, "Stay away from me. You are dirty, and you are scaring me."
Out from under the bed came the schoolbag, and it was a strange creature too.
The schoolbag said to Pat, "My friends came to scare you because you made me dirty! If you want them to leave, you have to wash me and clean me!"
When Pat understood that the strange creatures came from the dirt in his schoolbag, he washed the schoolbag right away.

Pat calmed down, because there were no more strange creatures to scare him.
Now he always makes sure to wash his schoolbag.
Since then he goes to school every day with a clean schoolbag.
